ashok: FYI noticed a big surge in eu-west1 around 03:12 — spot eviction spiked, some realtime requests saw 2x tail latency. wondering if we should tighten our regional reserve composition.

maria: ugh. can you paste the quick metrics? CPU/GPU pressure and preempt counts?

ashok: 03:10-03:16
- spot evictions: +42%
- on-demand utilization: 78% -> 95%
- queue latency p95: 420ms -> 980ms

kevin: not surprising — a nightly batch hit the same AZ. our global fallback routed more traffic to eu-west1 because us-west was limited.

jen: sounds like we need a short-term safety budget per region + a per-pool surge cap. min-on-demand should be regional, not global.

ashok: exactly. proposal: region_min_on_demand = max(0.12, observed_critical_share) and a transient_surge_buffer = 0.20 of total vGPU capacity to absorb AZ-level drains.

maria: +1. also add a preempt_score that prefers evicting lower-priority batches before anything serving inference. ranking should include (job_priority, idle_time, batch_size).

kevin: we should also avoid full realloc of instances during a surge — do a best-effort tiling: keep a stable core of on-demand pinned, only rotate burst spot nodes.

sre-bot: deploy-check: canary config keys validated: region_min_on_demand, surge_buffer_pct, preempt_score_weight

jen: sample config I sketched:
```
region_policy:
  eu-west1:
    min_on_demand_floor: 0.15
    surge_buffer_pct: 0.18
global_defaults:
  preempt_score_weights: {priority: 0.6, idle: 0.25, batch_size: 0.15}
  max_rebalance_rate: 0.05
```

maria: love that. one more constraint: when spot eviction rate > 30% in a 5m window, route new realtime to on-demand until on-demand util < 85%.

ashok: agree. also need to update routing logic so it can preferentially use warm K/V caches on on-demand nodes for sub-100ms tails.

kevin: ops considerations — set an alert for "region reserve dip" when on-demand falls below min_for_3m. auto-scale actions should not trigger >2 rebalances in 10m.

jen: can we simulate with the last 30 days trace and a synthetic AZ drain? want to estimate cost delta for 0.15 vs 0.10 min floor.

maria: I'll run a quick sim overnight and share numbers. rough expectation: 0.05 floor increase -> ~8-12% on-demand cost increase but p95 tail latency drop ~35% for realtime.

ashok: ok next steps: maria runs sim, kevin drafts a conservative rollout (canary eu-west1 -> eu-central1), jen will add config flags and gating, I will write short playbook for SRE on surge ops.

jen: noted — will add feature flags with rollout timeout + manual rollback hook.

sre-bot: noted: ticket created INFRA-5382 (reserve-composition-canary)

ashok: thanks all. keep replies short if you have objections. otherwise i'll start RFC doc tomorrow.
